title: The K1688 law is the unique negative-kurtosis symmetric three-point equality seed

family.negative_kurtosis: kappa_4<0 if and only if p>1/3.

classification.admissible_root: p_*=(15+sqrt(105))/60 is the unique root with p>1/3.
classification.consequence: X_* attains K1701's coefficient c_*=1/4; the other algebraic root has positive fourth cumulant and is outside the descent class.

scope_guard: Uniqueness is only inside the symmetric three-point family with negative fourth cumulant. Other bounded symmetric laws may also have kappa_6=0, and no finite-strength ordering follows.
